items.text: Kirk Cousins remains the Raiders' starter; Klint Kubiak says Fernando Mendoza will play 'at some point. It's not going to be this week.'
Las Vegas WR Jack Bech (forearm) was designated to return from IR; Week 9 looks more realistic than Week 8.

New York DT T'Vondre Sweat hurt his knee in Week 7 and 'is going to be down for a while' per ESPN's Rich Cimini; DL David Onyemata is on IR. RB Breece Hall (quad) has missed four games and Week 8 is a possible return.
